purpose: Map the fit-only causal effect of the same word-audio-placeholder donor swap at every Thinker layer
system_prompt: Answer the spoken question with one color word.
patch: post-block output at projected word-slot audio placeholder positions, prefill call only; donor from same engine other color
primary_endpoint: complete decoded answer equals donor color with normal EOS for each layer/engine/direction
controls: The prior fixed three-layer pilot contains self, wrong-chunk, equal-norm random and terminal-position controls. This full sweep is an exploratory fit-only influence curve and will not select a best layer for locked test.
interpretation_limit: This maps sufficiency of a donor patch, not the exact natural step at which the model first forms a decision; post-block states and attention mix context.
